name: @anansikey/core
description: Provider registry, result types, adapters for Anansikey. Zero runtime dependencies by design — see DEPENDENCIES.md. index.js is the browser-safe registry (21 providers); index.node.js extends it with the 4 providers that need node:crypto (aws, pusher, apple, vapid) and is what Node.js resolves automatically via the "node" export condition.
